input.command: cat fuzz/zz_cleanup.tmp 2>&1 || true; echo "---"; ls -la fuzz/corpus/ 2>&1; echo "---"; for d in fuzz/corpus/*/; do echo "EXISTS: $d"; done; echo "---HARNESS_CHECK---"; for h in $(ls fuzz/*.fuzz.cjs 2>/dev/null); do name=$(basename "$h" .fuzz.cjs); if [ -d "fuzz/corpus/$name" ]; then echo "OK: $name has corpus"; else echo "MISSING: $name needs corpus dir"; fi; done
